mapper.select: select t.yield from( SELECT TRIM(TO_CHAR(YIELD*100,99990.9999)) yield,row_number() over() as rownum FROM ( SELECT PA.YIELD FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE PA LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FIN ON FIN.CASH_ID = PA.CASH_ID WHERE FIN.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FIN.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{rateType} AND PA.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{tradeDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY PA.UPDATE_TIME DESC ) ) t WHERE t.ROWNUM = 1

select t.CCY from( SELECT CCY,row_number() over() as rownum FROM ( SELECT FIN.CCY FROM PA_FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE PA LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FIN ON FIN.CASH_ID = PA.CASH_ID WHERE FIN.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} ORDER BY FIN.UPDATE_TIME DESC ) ) t WHERE t.ROWNUM = 1

SELECT T.CLOSE_PRICE FROM ( SELECT M.CLOSE_PRICE,row_number() over() as rownum FROM MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE M
BASIS_CYY = #{basisCcy} AND TRADE_DATE < TO_DATE(#{tradeDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND QUOT_CYY = #{quotCcy} ORDER BY TRADE_DATE DESC
) T
T.ROWNUM = 1
